scope: Teacher Q4–Q8 / E5–E8 backend; isolated SQL and authored fixtures only

changes.problem: A stale enrichment revision reached costly PDF extraction before the command rejected it
changes.correction: Authority, existing idempotency receipt and expected revision are checked before conversion; transactional authority/CAS remains the second fence
changes.regression: A stale command containing a corrupt PDF returns revision_conflict before PDF validation and stores no source

changes.problem: PDF parser cleanup could mask no_text and limit failures as invalid_source
changes.correction: Capture the extraction outcome before best-effort parser cleanup; always terminate the bounded worker; expose only an allowlisted machine code
changes.regression: Actual PDF parser tests cover blank-only, mixed text/blank pages, 13 pages, excessive extracted text, corrupt PDF and successful extraction after failure

changes.problem: Unknown historical activity/visual type or schema could poison a dashboard or be mistaken for an executable current renderer
changes.correction: Public occurrence retains ID/revision/title or prompt/kind, availability=unsupported and empty renderer payload; never exposes solution/executable fields; answer commands reject unsupported versions
changes.regression: Unknown plugin, HTML visual and future completion schema remain readable while sentinel private payload is absent and mutation adds no event

changes.problem: A self-rating of forgetting updated scheduling without a traceable reinforcement recommendation
changes.correction: Rating1 stores an explicit self_reported_forgetting recommendation linked to the immutable rating event, with grants_verification=false. Rating events preserve previous schedule. Unknown policy versions do not silently execute the current scheduler Public cards expose availability; the queue orders current-policy ISO deadlines and leaves unsupported policies legible after supported cards.
changes.regression: A synthetic final submitted through the actual domain creates a verification; later forgotten-card rating is applied once and retains exactly that verification

changes.problem: Concept projection did not distinguish observed written correctness, independent evidence, reading and section verification or expose origins
changes.correction: Focal concept GET and dashboard expose version-scoped learning_state with separate observations, unknown retention, exact response/question/attempt origins, immutable equivalence history and verified source references. Proposed manual relationships preserve all-of target semantics and owner-scoped conditions without becoming facts or advancement gates
changes.regression: Unknown state before observation, synthetic domain final evidence after submission, exact original answer readback, joint derivation/contradiction, foreign target denial, exact citation, reversal history and current-version evidence exclusion

changes.problem: The disposable PostgreSQL readiness check could see the temporary Unix-only initialization server before its restart
changes.correction: The lab helper waits on 127.0.0.1 TCP via pg_isready -h; no production code or operational DB is involved

contracts.GET /teacher/sessions/:id/enrichment/con: Owned focal concept, learning_state, evidence_origins, up to8 proposed relations with up to4 all-of target IDs each, source_refs and last12 equivalence events. Does not traverse the graph
contracts.concept_create_optional_relations: [{kind:support|derivation|contradiction|prerequisite,target_concept_ids:UUID[1..4]}], maximum8; stored as proposed/user_authored/all and never grants advancement
contracts.concept_create_optional_source_refs: At most3 exact {source_id,content_hash,page,quote}, validated against same-session immutable source snapshot
contracts.learning_state: policy_version; visited material reference|null; immediate_check observation|null; independent_application correct independent written observation|null; retention:null; section_verification existing proof|null; latest_evidence; evidence_origins; grants_verification:false
contracts.activity_and_visual_availability: available|unsupported, schema_version1 on new occurrences; known legacy missing version remains readable; unsupported data is never substituted/executed

verification.command: npx oxlint <affected enrichment sources, controller, test and lab helper>

scenarios: Source replacement and immutable historical citation
Historical unsupported occurrence projection and mutation rejection
Concept states remain unknown without evidence
Forgetting event preserves existing synthetic final verification and idempotent rating
Concept response origin readback and separated written/independence/verification/retention
Joint proposed relations, contradiction, source refs, owner and reversal history
All four declarative activity contracts with CAS and no verification effects
Cross-plan reference retains observed date and written modality; reversal and stale revisions exclude it without copying grades
Constant query count at5 versus500 concepts, bounded20-item page and rejection over500
Two concurrent anchored thread commands with CAS, revised explicit second intent, lost receipt recovery and reverse-order publication bound to original thread

measurements.environment: Local disposable PostgreSQL16, synthetic authenticated actors, Windows Node; five samples per volume after population, no production claim
measurements.interpretation: The actual bounded endpoint projection did not add queries per concept at this volume. This is a volume baseline on the same implementation, not a before/after optimization, a distribution-tail guarantee or evidence of learning benefit

limits: No provider inference, operational account, native profile, operational DB, deployment or publication used by this subtask
No educational effectiveness, psychometric calibration, official level, retention probability or automatic hypothesis assertion
Proposed concept relations are manually authored, immutable content claims. They do not create advancement dependencies or automatically rewrite generations
A source is retained as extracted text/pages/hash, not an original downloadable PDF binary; no OCR is claimed
Global55TU acceptance must combine these backend results with root real-provider/pedagogical QA and integrated browser checks
